message.content:
The U.S. Declaration of Independence was signed by **56 delegates** from the thirteen colonies on August 2, 1776. Some of the most well‑known signers include:

| Signer | State / Colony |
|--------|----------------|
| John Hancock | Massachusetts (his signature is famously large) |
| Thomas Jefferson | Virginia (author of the draft) |
| Benjamin Franklin | Pennsylvania |
| John Adams | Massachusetts |
| Samuel Adams | Massachusetts |
| George Washington | Virginia (though he did not sign because he was commander‑in‑chief of the Continental Army) |
| Patrick Henry | Virginia |
| Alexander Hamilton | New York (did not sign; he was a delegate but not present at the signing) |

Other notable signers were James Madison, John Jay, Roger Sherman, and many others representing each colony. A complete list of all 56 signers can be found in the National Archives or the Library of Congress.
